summary: The write-and-open half of `coldstart graph`: reads the notebook for note anchors, calls buildGraphPayload, bakes the result into GRAPH_TEMPLATE and writes a single self-contained HTML file (default `<root>/.coldstart/graph.html`), then opens it in the OS browser. renderGraphHtml escapes `</` inside the baked JSON so a path or note title containing a closing script tag cannot break out of the script block. It also substitutes `<!--__HOME_LINK__-->` with the empty string — the standalone CLI page has nowhere to link back to, so any caller that wants that link (the site build) must substitute it into the TEMPLATE before calling this.
